sentences.text: Author: Tirthankar Ghosh Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh  M/L58 C.R.M.10174 of 2020 06.04.2026 Bpg.

In Re: An application for cancellation of bail under Section 439(2) of the Dismissed Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 filed in connection with Sabang Police Station Case No.147 of 2020 dated 03.07.2020 under Sections 498A/323/325/307/354/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code and 3/4 of D.P.Act;
Salema Bibi Versus The State of West Bengal & Ors.
Mr. Md. Anwar Hossain.
...for the State.

entities.text: Salema Bibi Versus The State of West Bengal & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The present application for cancellation of bail was preferred in the year 2020 challenging the order dated 24.07.2020 by the learned Sessions Judge.
Report reflects that charge- sheet was submitted and thereafter the case was committed to the court of sessions.
Charges have already been framed and evidence of first prosecution witness is in progress.

Having regard to the fact that the order of bail was passed more than 5 years 8 months ago and there has been no complain regarding the post bail conduct, at this belated stage, I am not inclined to interfere with the order of bail dated 24.07.2020.
Report submitted by the State be kept with the record.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance of all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
